title: Smart home hub
goal: Show resident control and security functions in a connected home.

rubric.must: Smart Home Hub visibly encloses the device-control and security use cases.
Create Automation has dashed «include» arrows pointing to Authenticate Resident and Read Weather.
Notify Monitoring Centre extends Arm Security toward the alarm triggered extension point.
Weather Service and Monitoring Centre are visibly external actors connected to their respective use cases.

ideal.notes: Independent reference drawing following visual-eval/exemplars/usecase/ideal.svg (sha256 7c0fac2f9989). Vision reviewed all six rasterized targets: named subject boundary, external actors, extension-point compartments, include arrows toward included use cases and extend arrows toward bases; long dependencies routed outside unrelated ellipses. Source and rubric unchanged; no engine rendering used as target.
